versions.content: Service Name Fr Nm_ Deactivate Tx Pn Shutdown Msg Syntax Std_ Return Type Fr Nm_ Deactivate Tx Pn Shutdown Msg ( Network Handle Type nm Channel Handle ) Service ID [hex] 0xf5 Sync/ Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant for different nm Channel Handle. Non reentrant for the same nm Channel Handle. Parameters (in) nm Channel Handle Identifier of the NM - Channel where the PNC shutdown process is stopped. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std _ Return Type E_ OK:Request has been accepted. E_ NOT_ OK: Request has not been accepted. Description NM indicate to deactive the transmission of PN shutdown messages on the given NM - Channel. This result in transmission of a usual NM - PDUs with PNSR bit set to 0. Available via Fr Nm.h
